strings.cfg_general__enabled_help: Off stops every Delve regeneration and room count change. Nothing already restored is undone.
strings.cfg_general__dry_run_all_help: On: every kind only reports what it would do and changes nothing (visits and remembered spots are still recorded).
strings.cfg_general__check_interval_seconds_help: How often Delve checks visits and real-time clocks. In-game day clocks are also checked at each dawn.
strings.cfg_general__max_actions_per_tick_help: At most this many sites are restored or reset per check, so the server never stalls; the rest wait for the next check.
strings.cfg_general__player_base_guard_help: Never touch a site inside a player base or a ward area.
strings.cfg_general__kick_command_fallback_help: Admins without Crucible can send Delve commands through the game's kick console command.
strings.cfg_general__status_report_lines_help: Lines of recent actions the status report keeps.
strings.cfg_rooms__room_counts_enabled_help: Off leaves every dungeon generator as the game made it. Only new dungeons and Delve full resets use room counts.
strings.cfg_rooms__min_rooms_help: The generator stops placing rooms once all required rooms exist and more than this many are placed, in every vanilla dungeon except Hildir's. Capped at 120 (larger values have corrupted worlds).
strings.cfg_rooms__max_rooms_help: Attempts the generator makes to place rooms in every vanilla dungeon except Hildir's. Never below the Min.
strings.cfg_rooms__forest_crypt_override_help: On: Burial Chambers dungeons use their own Min and Max below instead of the general pair.
strings.cfg_rooms__forest_crypt_min_rooms_help: The generator stops placing rooms once all required rooms exist and more than this many are placed, in the Burial Chambers. Capped at 120 (larger values have corrupted worlds).
strings.cfg_rooms__forest_crypt_max_rooms_help: Attempts the generator makes to place rooms in the Burial Chambers. Never below the Min.
strings.cfg_rooms__sunken_crypt_override_help: On: Sunken Crypt dungeons use their own Min and Max below instead of the general pair.
strings.cfg_rooms__sunken_crypt_min_rooms_help: The generator stops placing rooms once all required rooms exist and more than this many are placed, in a Sunken Crypt. Capped at 120 (larger values have corrupted worlds).
strings.cfg_rooms__sunken_crypt_max_rooms_help: Attempts the generator makes to place rooms in a Sunken Crypt. Never below the Min.
strings.cfg_rooms__cave_override_help: On: Frost Caves dungeons use their own Min and Max below instead of the general pair.
strings.cfg_rooms__cave_min_rooms_help: The generator stops placing rooms once all required rooms exist and more than this many are placed, in the Frost Caves. Capped at 120 (larger values have corrupted worlds).
strings.cfg_rooms__cave_max_rooms_help: Attempts the generator makes to place rooms in the Frost Caves. Never below the Min.
strings.cfg_dungeons__full_reset_clock_help: InGameDays counts world days since the trigger; RealHours counts wall-clock hours (UTC), also while the server is off.
strings.cfg_dungeons__full_reset_delay_help: Delay in the clock's unit since the last visit before a dungeon set to Full in Delve.Dungeons.yml is wiped and generated again. In-game days 0.25 to 3650, real hours 0.25 to 87600.
strings.cfg_dungeons__full_reset_dry_run_help: On: only report what would come back; change nothing.
strings.cfg_dungeons__full_reset_build_clearance: Any player piece inside a dungeon interior blocks its full reset; it is checked again at the next evaluation.
strings.cfg_dungeons__warn_at_entrance_help: Tell players at the entrance when the dungeon resets and that anything left inside is lost.
strings.cfg_chests__chests_help: Loot chests (world chests with a loot table) refill with a fresh roll after the delay. Player-built chests are never touched.
strings.cfg_chests__chest_clock_help: InGameDays counts world days since the trigger; RealHours counts wall-clock hours (UTC), also while the server is off.
strings.cfg_chests__chest_delay_help: Delay in the clock's unit from the first opening (or from being found empty) to the refill. In-game days 0.25 to 3650, real hours 0.25 to 87600.
strings.cfg_chests__reset_opened_help: On: an opened chest refills after the delay even with leftovers inside, which are replaced. Off: only empty chests are on a clock.
strings.cfg_chests__restock_loaded_help: On: the delay keeps running while a player has the chest loaded, and the new contents are written on the first check after the chest unloads. Off: a loaded chest is left alone until it unloads, and the delay starts then. Contents are never replaced while a loaded copy is still in memory.
strings.cfg_chests__chest_dry_run_help: On: only report what would come back; change nothing.
strings.cfg_chests__exclude_help: Chest prefabs never refilled, separated by commas (Hildir's quest chests by default). Changes apply at the next chest check or observation without restarting.
strings.cfg_chests__history_help: Tell the next opener who opened the chest first and last, and when.

strings.cfg_bosses__queen_return_help: The Queen returns to her citadel after her death and the delay without visitors. A living Queen's citadel is never touched.
strings.cfg_bosses__queen_clock_help: InGameDays counts world days since the trigger; RealHours counts wall-clock hours (UTC), also while the server is off.
strings.cfg_bosses__queen_delay_help: Delay in the clock's unit without visitors before the Queen returns. In-game days 0.25 to 3650, real hours 0.25 to 87600.
strings.cfg_bosses__queen_dry_run_help: On: only report what would come back; change nothing.
strings.cfg_bosses__close_sealed_door_help: Lock the citadel's sealed door again when the Queen returns.
strings.cfg_bosses__kall_return_help: Kall Fimbulbringer returns asleep to his Deep North boss room after his death and the delay without visitors. A room with Kall alive in any phase, or with a player inside, is never touched.

strings.cfg_surface__allow_surface_reset_help: Admins may bring back felled trees, bushes, mined rocks and ore, and picked stones, flint and branches in generated zones around them by command (delve-surface, Thing's Reset resources and Regenerate nature). Never automatic.
strings.cfg_surface__surface_base_clearance_help: Meters (flat) around anything a player built where a surface reset brings nothing back; ward and base areas always count. 0 turns the building check off.
strings.cfg_surface__surface_reset_radius_help: A surface reset covers the generated zones this many meters around the admin who asks for it (zones must be loaded on the server).
strings.cfg_notices__notify_help: Tell players what comes back and when (chests, dungeon entrances, biome entry). Off silences every Delve notice.
strings.cfg_notices__biome_notice_cooldown_minut: A player is told about a biome's regeneration at most once in this many minutes.
strings.cfg_notices__server_language_help: Language of plain-text notices for players without Crucible: English, Korean, Spanish, Chinese, Russian, French or German.
strings.cfg_cheats__regenerate_without_waiting_h: On: an admin's regenerate-now command brings a site back at once, without waiting for its delay. Players near and player buildings still block it.
strings.cfg_creature_respawn__camps_help: Bring back the creatures of cleared camps and villages (one-shot spawners outside dungeons).

strings.cfg_creature_respawn__dungeon_spawners_h: Bring back the creatures of cleared dungeons (one-shot spawners inside interiors).
